title: Lost or Stolen Debit and Credit Card Blocking Policy
content: If a debit or credit card is lost, stolen, damaged, or suspected of compromise, the cardholder must hotlist it immediately through the Mobile Banking App Card Controls section, Internet Banking, or emergency IVR assistance. Permanent card hotlisting takes effect immediately and cannot be undone; all ATM, POS, and online transactions are blocked instantly. A replacement chip-and-PIN card is dispatched to the registered communication address within 5 to 7 business days.

title: ATM and Debit Card Green PIN Generation Policy
content: Callers requesting a new card PIN or resetting a forgotten ATM PIN should use Mobile Banking Card Services or visit any bank ATM to generate a Green PIN using registered mobile OTP verification. Support agents and automated voice systems never ask for, view, or verbally recite a customer's existing PIN or CVV. If a card is blocked due to 3 incorrect PIN attempts, it unlocks automatically after 24 hours.

title: Debit Card Variants, Daily Cash Withdrawal, and POS Spending Limits
content: Daily withdrawal and purchase limits depend on debit card tier: Classic/Silver cards have an ATM cash limit of ₹40,000 and POS/Online limit of ₹1,00,000; Platinum cards have an ATM limit of ₹1,00,000 and POS/Online limit of ₹3,00,000; Signature/World cards offer an ATM limit of ₹1,50,000 and POS limit of ₹5,00,000. Contactless (NFC) Tap-to-Pay transactions are permitted up to ₹5,000 per transaction without entering an ATM PIN; transactions above ₹5,000 mandate PIN entry.

title: Emergency Card Blocking and Account Freeze via SMS
content: Customers without internet or smartphone access can block their cards instantly by sending an SMS from their registered mobile number: Send 'BLOCK <Last 4 digits of card>' to 567676. A confirmation SMS with an incident reference number is received within 30 seconds. To freeze all banking debits including NetBanking and UPI, send 'FREEZE <Account Number>' to 567676.

title: International Usage, Dynamic Spending Limits, and RBI Card Safety Mandate
content: Under RBI security regulations, all newly issued debit and credit cards have international transactions, online e-commerce, and contactless tap-and-pay disabled by default. Cardholders must activate these channels manually inside the Mobile Banking app under 'Card Controls'. Users can dynamically toggle International ON/OFF, set custom daily limits for domestic and overseas transactions, and restrict ATM cash withdrawals.

title: Credit Card Billing Cycle, Payment Due Date, and Interest-Free Grace Period
content: Credit card statements are generated on a fixed calendar date each month (e.g., 15th). The Payment Due Date is typically 20 to 25 days after the statement date, providing an interest-free grace period of up to 50 days on retail purchases. The interest-free period applies only if the total outstanding balance from the previous statement was paid in full. Cash withdrawals at ATMs on credit cards carry no grace period and incur interest from the date of withdrawal.

title: Credit Card Minimum Amount Due (MAD) and Finance Charges (APR)
content: The Minimum Amount Due (MAD) is 5% of the total outstanding statement balance, plus all applicable EMI installments, taxes, and fees, with a minimum floor of ₹250. Paying only the MAD prevents late payment fees and protects the cardholder's credit score, but the remaining unpaid balance attracts finance charges between 3.50% to 3.75% per month (42% to 45% p.a.) calculated from the date of each transaction until full settlement.

title: Credit Card Reward Points, Expiry Policy, and Redemption Portal
content: Cardholders earn reward points on eligible retail, dining, and online spending. Reward points are valued between ₹0.25 to ₹1.00 each depending on card tier and can be redeemed for flight and hotel bookings, shopping e-vouchers (Amazon, Flipkart), merchandise, or direct statement credit. Reward points remain valid for 24 to 36 months from the date of accrual. A nominal redemption fee of ₹99 plus GST applies per catalog order.

title: Domestic and International Airport Lounge Access Rules and Eligibility
content: Complimentary airport lounge access is available on eligible Platinum, Signature, and Infinite debit and credit cards. Domestic lounge access provides 1 to 4 complimentary visits per calendar quarter, subject to a minimum spend threshold (e.g., ₹10,000 in the preceding quarter on select cards). Cardholders present their physical card or generate a QR pass on the mobile app, with a ₹2 authorization charge for swipe validation.

title: Card Replacement Charges, Damaged Chip Reissue, and Expiry Renewal
content: Reissue of an expired card is done automatically free of cost, dispatched 30 days prior to the expiration month printed on the card. If a card is damaged, cracked, or has a faulty EMV chip, a replacement card can be ordered via the app free of charge upon returning or deactivating the old card. Replacement fee for a lost or stolen standard card is ₹200 plus GST, while premium tier cards receive complimentary replacement.

title: Credit Limit Enhancement and Upgrade Eligibility Criteria
content: Cardholders who maintain a consistent repayment history, maintain low credit utilization (under 30%), and have a healthy credit score (CIBIL 750+) are eligible for periodic pre-approved credit limit increases. Customers can view and accept pre-approved limit increase offers with zero paperwork in Mobile Banking under 'Offers'. Manual requests can be submitted by uploading latest salary slips or ITR documentation.

title: ATM Cash Withdrawal Failure (Debited but Cash Not Dispensed) and Compensation
content: If an ATM debits your account but fails to dispense cash due to machine malfunction or network timeout, the funds are automatically reversed by the acquiring bank. Under RBI rules, failed ATM transactions must be reversed within T+5 business days. If the bank fails to reverse within 5 business days, the cardholder is entitled to a delayed compensation penalty of ₹100 per day of delay directly credited to their bank account.

title: Credit Card Transaction to EMI Conversion (Smart EMI) Guidelines
content: Credit card transactions of ₹2,500 and above can be converted into flexible Equated Monthly Installments (EMIs) across tenures of 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, or 24 months. Conversion can be requested inside the Mobile Banking app before statement generation. Interest rates range from 13.00% to 16.50% p.a. on a reducing balance basis, with a nominal processing fee of 1% (min ₹99). Gold and jewelry purchases are excluded from EMI conversion.

title: Instant Virtual Debit Card Issuance and Dynamic CVV Features
content: Customers can generate an Instant Virtual Debit Card inside the Mobile Banking app immediately upon account opening without waiting for physical plastic delivery. The virtual card is valid for domestic and international online transactions. To protect against online card theft, the app supports dynamic 3-digit CVV generation that refreshes every 5 minutes, ensuring card details cannot be reused if compromised on merchant websites.

title: Card Swallowed or Captured Inside ATM Machine Resolution Protocol
content: If a card is swallowed or retained inside an ATM machine due to power outage, hardware jam, or session timeout, the cardholder should immediately block the card via mobile app or emergency IVR (press 0). Captured cards at off-site ATMs are destroyed by cash logistics agencies under RBI security standards to prevent misuse; a replacement card is issued free of cost to the cardholder upon filing a capture complaint.
